{{TierBar}}

'''Assimara Parasites''' are a tier of [[Mobs|Parasites]] consisting of specialized forms of [[Assimilated Mobs]]. In the hierarchy, they are above [[Assimilated Mobs]], but below [[Feral Parasites]].

== Spawning ==
Assimara Parasites spawn naturally from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] when enough of their Sane counterpart has been assimilated.

== Features ==
*Assimara Parasites' melee attacks will inflict [[Call Of The Hive]] I.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Like all Parasites, Assimaras present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).

== ''Survival Guides'' ==
These units are stronger versions of their respective [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated versions]].
